More about Hogaru
Made with AI Edit
Hogaru is a Colombian company that provides professional cleaning services for both households and businesses.
The company operates through a digital platform that allows clients to book cleaning services on-demand, for either 4 or 8-hour periods, seven days a week. The services are available in major Colombian cities, including Bogotá, Medellín, and Cali, as well as the Sabana de Bogotá region.
Hogaru appears to generate revenue by taking a commission or fee for each service booked through its platform.
In addition to its standard cleaning services, the company also offers a feature called "Hogaru Encuentra", which facilitates the direct hiring of domestic help, providing clients with a comprehensive solution for their household needs.
